scenarios.title: Broken Nginx — connection refused
scenarios.objective: Nginx is installed but not serving on port 80. Restore the site.

scenarios.title: Disk full — can't write logs
scenarios.objective: Application can't write logs because the disk is full (or inode exhaustion). Free space without deleting critical data.

scenarios.title: Permission denied on deploy path
scenarios.objective: Deploy user cannot write to the app directory. Fix ownership/permissions the least-privilege way.

scenarios.title: Cron job not firing
scenarios.objective: A backup cron job never runs. Diagnose and fix scheduling/environment issues.

scenarios.title: SSH lockout risk — fix sshd_config
scenarios.objective: sshd is misconfigured (bad PermitRootLogin / PasswordAuthentication / AllowUsers). Fix without locking yourself out.

scenarios.title: Port conflict — app won't bind
scenarios.objective: Nimbus API fails to start because something else holds port 8080. Identify and resolve.

scenarios.title: DNS resolution broken in container
scenarios.objective: Container can't resolve external hostnames. Fix resolv.conf / Docker DNS.

scenarios.title: Postgres auth failed
scenarios.objective: App returns 500; Postgres rejects credentials after a secret rotation went wrong.

scenarios.title: OOM killer struck the worker
scenarios.objective: Background worker keeps dying. Find OOM evidence and constrain / fix memory use.

scenarios.title: TLS certificate expired
scenarios.objective: Nginx serves expired self-signed cert. Issue a new local cert and reload safely.

scenarios.title: Half-open firewall
scenarios.objective: iptables allows SSH but blocks app traffic asymmetrically. Restore correct rules.

scenarios.title: Docker zombie — container restart loop
scenarios.objective: A compose service is crash-looping. Use logs/inspect to find the root cause and fix the image/config.

scenarios.title: Kubernetes CrashLoopBackOff
scenarios.objective: Nimbus pod on Kind is CrashLoopBackOff. Diagnose events, logs, probes, and config.

scenarios.title: Kubernetes service has no endpoints
scenarios.objective: Service selector doesn't match pods. Traffic fails. Fix labels/selectors.

scenarios.title: Time drift breaks JWT auth
scenarios.objective: Auth tokens invalid due to clock skew in the lab container. Fix time sync.

scenarios.title: SQS consumer lag (LocalStack)
scenarios.objective: Messages pile up; worker not consuming. Fix queue URL/permissions/env.

scenarios.title: S3 access denied after IAM change
scenarios.objective: App lost S3 access after policy edit. Restore least-privilege access.

scenarios.title: Load balancer health checks failing
scenarios.objective: ALB/nginx upstream health checks fail. App is up but health path wrong.

scenarios.title: Git detached HEAD on deploy server
scenarios.objective: Deploy server is in detached HEAD; releases can't pull. Fix branch tracking.

scenarios.title: Ansible unreachable hosts
scenarios.objective: Playbook fails on unreachable inventory hosts. Fix SSH keys/inventory.
